result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for humans to feel certain about their own righteousness.

Most cruelty, war, and destruction comes from people who are absolutely sure they’re right. If everyone had a built-in, undeniable sense of their own fallibility — a constant little tremor of doubt beneath every conviction — then debate might replace violence, curiosity might replace contempt, and the world might finally learn to listen instead of conquer.
